entry.title: Automatic Outreach Materials with AI
entry.content:
The use of AI in many areas of science is taking off, but how about using using LLM to quickly generate outreach materials by giving it a recent paper published and getting a few minute overview at a suitable level for public dissemination?

I tried this last week with a recent paper by my student: A. D. Brooks et al. Phys. Rev. C 111, 024002 (2025) and passing it into the Google NotebookLM where after ten minutes or so you can generate a video overview of whatever content you upload. See the results below:

While it is not perfect and is no substitution for a human-generated effort, it does a pretty good job at highlighting the key important factors of the paper and may generate some useful examples of how to explain this to non-specialists. The future is bright…

entry.title: Neutrons are blue - a manifesto
entry.content:
A manifesto:

Neutrons are blue

Protons are red

Electrons are yellow

Gamma photons are green

Deuterons are orange

Alpha particles are purple
